solutionSearchEvidence: Merged Naki motion core already exposes createNakiBattleMagicMotionController and requires explicit identity verification.
Current Battle cinematic mount resolves a characterId and then creates a character-specific presentation motion controller beside the shared character runtime.
A standalone adapter can compose those two existing contracts without touching the actively-owned shared Battle mount.
The adapter will not default or infer a Naki character ID; it only activates when caller-provided nakiCharacterId exactly equals characterId.
